sentences.text:
on 18
August, 2015
 1
 Cr.R. No. 704/2015
 (Chandrashekher Vs. State of M.P.)
18/08/2015
 Shri D.S. Tomar, Advocate for the petitioner.

Shri Rajendra Singh Yadav, Public Prosecutor for the
respondent/State.
Heard on I.A. No. 6955/2015, an application for suspension of sentence filed under Section 397(1)
of Cr.P.C. on behalf of the petitioner Chandrashekher.

The petitioner has been convicted by JMFC, Gajbashoda, District Vidisha, in Criminal Case No.1110/2005 vide judgment dated 09.02.2012 under Section 7(i) read with Section 16(1)(A)(i)
Prevention of Food Adulteration Act 1954, sentenced to Six months rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs.1000/- with default stipulation of one month additional rigorous imprisonment and under Section 7(v) read with Section 16(1)(A)(ii) Prevention of Food Adulteration Act 1954, sentenced to Six months rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs.1000/- with default stipulation one month additional rigorous imprisonment.
The petitioner preferred appeal before Ist ASJ, Vidisha, which was decided on 10.08.2015 by confirming the judgment and conviction passed by the trial Court.
Aggrieved by this, the petitioner preferred this revision.
On behalf of the petitioner, it is submitted that the petitioner was already on bail during the trial.
Fine amount has already been deposited.
His sentence has been suspended by the Trial Court for a limited period.
The total period of sentence imposed is less than three years.

On the above grounds,
petitioner prayed for bail.
Learned Panel Lawyer for the State opposed the application.

Considering the above facts, application is allowed and it is directed that the substantive jail sentence awarded to the petitioner shall remain suspended till the disposal of this revision and he be released on bail on depositing the fine amount, if not deposited, and on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for regular appearance before the Principal Registrar of this Court on 13.10.2015 and thereafter on such dates as may be fixed by the office for his presence during the pendency of this case.

(S.K. Palo) Judge LJ*
